about_the_game:
About the Game

Fear of Reptiles is a Dinosaur Horror game that brings dinosaurs into our world. Experience being hunted by a clever AI that will hunt you down by using multiple senses like sight, hearing, and smell. No where is safe as the longer you stick around, the more likely it will find you, so complete your mission quickly, and GET OUT.

Dense fog covers the night, reducing your vision and allowing these creatures to see you, before you see them.

Story Description

When prehistoric predators return to reclaim Earth, your mission is to survive. In this stealth horror experience, you’ll navigate a world overrun by ruthless dinosaurs, desperate to find shelter in emergency bunkers. In order to survive, you must:

  • Stay Quiet and don't make a sound as creatures lurking in the night can hear you and will hunt you down.

  • Outsmart your obstacles by causing distractions to form new paths Use objects you can find like rocks to throw, or tools to tear open spaces.

  • Hide when they get too close, like old toilets or tuck under small spaces, and hope they don't find you.

Features:

  • Intelligent AI that will hunt you down if it suspects something is around.

  • First Person Stealth limiting your vision, so you have to use your other senses to escape

  • Microphone Detection that simulates you having to be quiet

content_descriptors.notes: Some scenes may be described or depicted with blood
